hooks.command: for M in "$HOME"/.claude/projects/*/memory; do [ -d "$M/.git" ] || continue; git -C "$M" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null | grep -q effata-social-memory || continue; git -C "$M" pull --ff-only -q 2>/dev/null; done; true

for M in "$HOME"/.claude/projects/*/memory; do [ -d "$M/.git" ] || continue; git -C "$M" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null | grep -q effata-social-memory || continue; git -C "$M" add -A 2>/dev/null; git -C "$M" commit -q -m "auto-sync memoria $(date +'%F %H:%M')" 2>/dev/null; git -C "$M" push -q 2>/dev/null; done; true
